topics.description: The federal government has deferred $91 million in Minnesota Medicaid funding citing fraud vulnerabilities. This is part of a larger investigation into potential fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota Medicaid funding fraud investigation

topics.reason: New developments in Somali fraud allegations
